scope.excluded_note: A Level topics 6.1-10.4 are excluded at qualification level by the AS_ONLY route; no topic-level exclusions.

prerequisites_inherited.note: Concepts a learner must already hold before this topic is taught. Drawn from the Stage 3 dependency graph.

target_learner_profile.prior_teaching: Has been taught the full AS course. These notes consolidate and extend rather than introduce.
note_purpose: source of record for flashcard and learning-item generation
offline reading when the YYeni platform is unavailable
target_learner_profile.self_containment: Notes must stand alone. A learner reading offline cannot ask a follow-up question, so every mechanism, formula and worked example is written out in full.
target_learner_profile.context: Namibian secondary learners, Cambridge AS route, English medium.

assessment_expectations.ao4_rule: AO4 is measured in practice time, not item count. Every AO4-bearing objective carries at least one evaluation item.

depth_constraints.decision: Vitalis, 2026-09-07 - notes are the source for flashcards AND the offline study text, so they are written at teaching depth, not condensed to revision depth. Word count is not a constraint.
depth_constraints.excluded_constructs_reason: Beyond AS, or belonging to another topic. Full costing is NOT excluded: syllabus 5.4.2 names it explicitly. Recorded before authoring so the deterministic suite can enforce scope from the first draft.
depth_constraints.item_budget_note: 92 items. Planned at 86 in Stage 5. Raised to 88 during authoring, to 91 after review issue SR-9609-5.4-CODEX-R1-003 added three graphical items, and to 92 after SR-9609-5.4-CODEX-R2-001 added the drawing task. The bank total of 889 predates RS-22 and RS-37 enforcement and must be recomputed once a third topic is authored. Raised to 105 on 2026-09-12: the R3 exposure remap moved 13 objectives out of unmeasured_bullet_level into measured classes, which brought their coverage-floor subtypes into force (RS-05). Thirteen cards were authored where the floor subtype fits the objective - ITEM-093 to ITEM-105 - and eleven floors were waived in writing in subtype_waivers where it does not. Authority: the exposure classes, not a planning estimate. C-42 now fails the build if this number and the live bank disagree, so a repair cannot silently outgrow the contract again (review R4-004).

source_and_research_permissions.grant: Authorisation to use the sources held in this repository for the YYeni build.

sources: SRC-CIE9609-SYL-001 (the syllabus, for scope and objective wording)
derive_freely.note: Original writing carries no third-party dependency. It is the cleanest provenance available and the preferred route wherever a topic is rated generate_gap.

sources: all official_assessment sources - past papers, mark schemes, examiner reports
mine_do_not_reproduce.permitted: Analysis of assessment demand: command words, mark tariffs, AO focus, question contexts, examiner-evidenced misconceptions.
mine_do_not_reproduce.not_permitted: Reproducing question text or mark-scheme wording in learner-facing output. Mine the demand, write the answer yourself.

sources: the unattributed chapter notes and single-topic PDFs
reference_only.note: May inform and orient the author. Claims must be independently authored and verified; nothing is quoted or paraphrased closely.

outside_the_derivation_path.reason: A complete commercial publication, scanned, licence unverified. It covers little that original writing does not cover better, so excluding it costs nothing.

source_and_research_permissions.residual_note: YYeni can authorise its own use of what it holds. It cannot grant the rights of a third-party publisher. The policy above is built so that nothing in the derivation path depends on those rights: scope comes from the syllabus, demand comes from mining, and substance comes from original authoring.
source_and_research_permissions.publication_rule: Publication still requires RS-12 verification and RS-28 independent semantic review. Granting source permission unblocks authoring, not publication. Jurisdiction-sensitive claims additionally require human approval under RS-13 and RS-23.
source_and_research_permissions.external_research: Permitted against named authoritative sources, recorded as verified_external with a locator.

required_outputs.note: Set 2026-09-08 at Stage 11. The Stage 5 value of 19 was an objective count, not a content-unit count - the same defect review SR-9609-5.2-CODEX-R2-012 found in the 5.2 contract. Corrected before authoring rather than after review.

notes: Exposure split recomputed 2026-09-12 from curriculum/exam-exposure.json after the R3-004 remap. The earlier 3/2/1 split predated the semantic re-mapping and the amended class definitions.

Subtype waivers added 2026-09-12. The exposure class floor names subtypes; where a named subtype does not fit the objective, or would duplicate a card held elsewhere, the waiver records why in writing rather than padding the bank to satisfy a count (RS-05, RS-26). C-27 reports every waiver on every run.

subtype_waivers.reason: The objective is the need for accurate cost information. It names no pair of confusable ideas to distinguish; the contrast it does carry - under-costing against over-costing - is taught in CU-9609-5.4.1 block 5.4.1-b3 and practised by ITEM-9609-5.4-002-WHY and -003-CHAIN.

Fixed and variable costs reach 3 marks at most across six years of evidence. The class floor gives EVAL on frequency, not tariff, and 12-mark evaluation practice is the scarcest resource in the item budget; it is spent on the objectives that are actually examined at that tariff.

The distinction this objective would carry is full costing against contribution costing, which is taught in CU-9609-5.4.2 and practised by ITEM-9609-5.4-021-DIST under OBJ-9609-5.4.2-01. A second card on the same boundary would be a semantic duplicate (RS-26).

The nature of contribution costing has no internal distinction; its boundary against full costing is practised by ITEM-9609-5.4-021-DIST, and contribution against profit by ITEM-9609-5.4-031-DIST under OBJ-9609-5.4.2-04.
Contribution is defined by ITEM-9609-5.4-027-DEF under OBJ-9609-5.4.4-02-02 and profit by ITEM-9609-5.4-101-DEF. This objective is the difference between them, which is carried by its DIST card.
The definable term is contribution costing, defined by ITEM-9609-5.4-020-DEF under OBJ-9609-5.4.2-03. A limitation is not a term with a definition.
The definable term is contribution costing, defined by ITEM-9609-5.4-020-DEF under OBJ-9609-5.4.2-03. This objective is about the situations it suits, carried by ITEM-9609-5.4-096-DIST.

The objective names no pair to distinguish. The comparison it does require - this period against plan, against an earlier period, or between departments - is taught in CU-9609-5.4.3 and practised by the INTERP and CHAIN cards on this objective.
The boundary that matters here is a special-order price against a long-run price, practised by ITEM-9609-5.4-100-DIST under OBJ-9609-5.4.3-02 and applied by ITEM-9609-5.4-053-APP.

Margin of safety reaches 3 marks at most across six years. It is classed probed_high on frequency, and its evaluative weight is carried inside the break-even evaluations at OBJ-9609-5.4.4-03, where the 12-mark questions actually sit.
Break-even analysis is defined by ITEM-9609-5.4-056-DEF under OBJ-9609-5.4.4-01. Its uses and limitations are not separately definable.

Direct and indirect costs reach 3 marks at most across six years of evidence. The R4-002 remap moved this objective to probed_high on frequency rather than tariff, and the class floor gives EVAL on that basis; 12-mark evaluation practice is the scarcest resource in the item budget and is spent on the objectives actually examined at that tariff. The evaluative weight of allocation is carried by ITEM-9609-5.4-025-EVAL under OBJ-9609-5.4.2-02.
